usedFor: WiziShop holds your store customers, and Freshsales Classic opens a deal for them through “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “Customer Event” in WiziShop, then “Create Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: A customer event opens a deal linked to an account, so sales picks it up.

watchOut: “Customer Event” fires on created, updated and deleted customers, so one customer can open several deals.
